name: Corridor
description: Red emergency lights pulse across the walls. Through the big window the alien planet glows – so close, and yet out of reach if the air runs out.

name: Crew Quarters
description: Bunks, a knocked-over mug, photos on the wall. The emergency lights bathe everything in a faint blue. At the far end: a locked security bulkhead.

name: Laboratory
description: Samples from the planet float in glowing glass tanks. In the corner the oxygen generator is smoking, and the wall is torn open where the meteorite scraped the hull.

name: Saved
description: The generator hums steadily again. Fresh air flows through the ship – and a few hours later you touch down gently on the red planet.

name: Out of Air
description: Breathing gets harder, your vision blurs. The generator didn't come back online in time.
